constraint_findings.finding: The 600 V reference candidate's required rating follows from an ASSUMED ~400 V MOV-clamped terminal voltage, not from the controller's 700 V node limit; the MOV is absent from the power-entry candidate BOM and would have to be added.

The high-side gate-source voltage is ~8.5 V typical, not Vregd 10.7 V; the 10 V Rds(on) data is not directly applicable to the high side (1.009x per-point) and is only marginally optimistic on the low side (1.0006x at the 9.91 V minimum).

The worst-case bootstrap gate voltage (7.59 V with 220 nF) is CONDITIONAL on typical Qg; no guaranteed worst case can be constructed because Qg has no published maximum. The 220 nF choice is a robustness margin, not a proven necessity.
The IPW60R017C7 body diode is slow (Qrr typ 18 uC at 58.2 A / 400 V); a fast-body-diode device may be required for the active bridge, which would change Rds(on) and the saving.
The line-to-PE (2 kV) common-mode stress is not clamped by the L-N MOV and is INDETERMINATE from the captured sources.

answer: CORRECTED and CONDITIONAL. The four downgraded claims are fixed: per-device conduction is 0.5*R*I_rms^2 averaged over four devices (~1.95 W typ, not 3.91 W); the 98% worst-bracket saving is 14.05 W at P_bridge=23 W (the ~26 W figure was the best bracket point); F_VGS_HS is now derived per point (1.009-1.029, not an assumed 1.020) and F_VGS_LS is 0.9996-1.0026 (the 1.000 constant was invalid at the 9.91 V minimum); the 43 mW recovery figure is a sensitivity, not a bound; and the voltage table is replaced by a terminal-voltage derivation that does not equate the controller's 700 V limit with a MOSFET requirement. Revised typical P_saved = 15.23 / 20.54 / 27.23 W and 98%-curve P_saved = 14.05 / 19.36 / 26.05 W across 23 / 28.30 / 35 W. The saving is not protected: it is conditional on an ASSUMED MOV clamp (~400 V) and on typical device data, and unknown recovery/inrush/EMI losses are not subtracted from it.

single_missing_input.input: The MOV's clamp voltage at the specified surge waveform: a captured Littelfuse LA-series V150LA10AP 8/20 us V-I characteristic, or a measured clamp.
single_missing_input.why: It is the one terminal-voltage number from which BOTH the MOSFET's required voltage rating and the controller's node stress are derived, and it is currently ASSUMED at ~400 V because both capture attempts returned HTTP 403. Without it the 600 V reference candidate's adequacy cannot be established in either direction, and no voltage-derivation conclusion here is a bound.
